title: 朝日杯FSの後に・燃ゆる炎

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's eyes burn bright with passion as she runs, and it is this moment that convinces Yaeno Muteki she is a worthy foe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, Yaeno Muteki is training into the night, and Sakura Chiyono O's own motivation skyrockets upon seeing her working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky watches fondly as Sakura Chiyono O is spurred on by her friend, all while carrying the dream Maruzensky gave her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Mr. C.B., standing beside her, doesn't seem pleased by the attitude she sees in Maruzensky's gaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Sakura Chiyono O has yet to realize the intention behind their distant stares. For now, all she can do is prepare for the Satsuki Sho.
